method: Each guard mutated alone in the working tree by exact text replacement, the named test run alone (vitest -t), the file restored and its SHA-256 compared with the original, then the test rerun. All 29 ran on the final code at aeec852. Integration tests ran on local PostgreSQL 18.6 with the real schema built from the migrations; PayPal is the labeled fixture fake at the PayPalWriteClient boundary and webhook signatures use the fixture postback.
